evidence_kind: offline engineering fixtures; operator-reported launch failure

incident.source: User report and supplied ../execskill-m9fix-dry_anchor_env.py (read, not executed)
incident.alfworld_anchor_units: 2/10 total anchor units still preparing views; not evidence of success
incident.failure: configuration / ValueError after opening the panel, before the first model call or ledger reservation

cause: units.cell_context sets environment for main-v9. v225_read.context_for copies a validated Context and sets the B arm card to ''. cells.run_cell then used dataclasses.replace(context, environment=None), rerunning Context.__post_init__ and instruction_start.active_cards. The legitimate blank read card fails chain-level fixed-format/historical-card validation. Environment-less fixtures did not execute this rebuild.

fix.change: Only when profiles.is_v225(context.configuration), shallow-copy the already constructed arm context inside the acquired environment lock, set only the copy's environment to None, and recurse. All other configurations retain the original replace expression.
fix.why: The wrapper only disables recursive lock acquisition; it must preserve the already selected read-arm cards/runtime. This is smaller than adding a validation exception or a new Context mode, and does not relax Context.__post_init__, active_cards, Setting validation, learning/gate/practice construction or their dataclasses.replace paths.
fix.request_contract: B still has an empty card, an empty package and no guidance text. C0/C complete system/user requests match their previously working environment-less requests byte for byte. Caller Context, nominal tokens, endpoints, pools and runtime remain intact.

audit.context_rebuilds: v225_read.context_for and fresh_plan already use copies without revalidation. evaluate_unit uses the same context_for -> run_cells -> run_cell path for every event. units.for_unit/Setting replacements and units.cell_context validate before arm substitution. step.py learning/acceptance replacements remain strict. No second post-arm Context rebuild or legitimate-arm rejection was found.
audit.alfworld: evaluation.alfworld_reset/_with_views rebuild task dictionaries only. Episode holds, live reset/view hashes and solver session cleanup retain the selected Context; no second validation.
audit.spreadsheetbench: Panel qualification precedes arm substitution. Solver precheck/generation and cells._score retain Context; scoring copies runtime, adds a per-score transient directory, and holds the native pool.
audit.zebralogic: C/C_end retain the nonempty pinned historical Context card; historical_runtime makes solver._system omit its guidance. B alone gets an empty Context card. Do not confuse emitted guidance with stored historical card validation.
audit.chain_D: units.cell_context creates nominal tokens; cells._shell forwards them unchanged. manifest.make_solver/v225_client's thinking-disabled route B client does not inspect arm cards. Existing v219 cross-arm and v220 import guards do not apply to main-v9.
audit.smoke: Existing practice decomposition/price B arms keep a validated Context card until _shell selects blank guidance. A blanket test-unit-only Arm restriction would change that existing smoke path and was not introduced. No chain-level empty-card exception was added.
